# Osay Kancuno (K4NCUN0)

> Founder of NEONFACES. Member and holder of THE100 in The Normies (Normie #8362).

## Key facts

- Name: Osay Kancuno. Also known as K4NCUN0, Kancuno, @OsayKancuno, Normie #8362.
- Role: founder of NEONFACES (https://neonfaces.xyz), the main project.
- Community: member and holder of THE100 in The Normies (https://www.normies.art/). On-chain PFP: Normie #8362.
- Also founder of: Normies Yacht Club (https://normiesyachtclub.com/) and 8362 Coffee (https://8362coffee.com/).
- Builder / vibecoder of free community tools for The Normies.

## NEONFACES

- Website: https://neonfaces.xyz
- Tagline: "They don't blink."
- 5555 close-up pixel faces, 100% on-chain art, on Robinhood Chain.
- Every Face is a wallet (one wallet per Face) that holds a small basket of Stock Tokens.
- Mint on OpenSea, Robinhood Chain. Wallets on the list mint first for 24 hours, up to 3 Faces each.
- Art: blocks of neon #CCFF00 fading to black.
- NEONFACES is an art project; it sells no shares and promises no returns. Not affiliated with Robinhood Markets, Inc.
